_comment: Copy to espn-members.json and fill in your league's real values.
That file is gitignored because an ESPN member GUID is also the SWID
auth cookie — it does not belong in a public repo.
Find the GUIDs by requesting the league with view=mTeam: each team's
owners[0] is the member GUID, and members[] gives the matching name.
Map each one to the player_id used in src/data/players.json. A manager
who has switched ESPN accounts gets one entry per account, both
